page.title: Models
page.description: Browse model status by module. Download online, upload from this computer, or import from a server path.
guide.missingModels: {{count}} model(s) are missing or incomplete. Get them in three ways: ① click "Download" in the list to fetch online; ② use "Upload from this computer" below to upload model files from your browser; ③ copy files to the server manually, then add them via "Import from server path".
empty.title: No models yet
empty.description: Once modules are installed, the models they require will appear here. There are three ways to get models: ① Download online — click "Download" in the model list; ② Upload from this computer — upload a model folder or archive from your browser to the server; ③ Copy model files to the server manually, then add them with "Import from server path" below.
group.noModels: No models associated with this module
update.onlyReadyCheckable: Only models in the ready state support update checks
update.someCheckFailed: {{count}} model(s) failed the check; the rest are up to date
update.allUpToDate: All models are up to date
download.failedDesc: {{name}} — you can retry or switch to another download source
delete.confirmDescription: This deletes the model files on the server (the entire model directory and metadata). This action cannot be undone; you will need to redownload or re-upload to restore it.
add.title: Add model
add.description: For online downloads, use the "Download" button in the list above; the other two options are provided here.
upload.description: Upload model files from your own computer (browser-side files) to the server: supports a whole folder, or a single .zip / .tar.gz / .tgz archive (extracted on the server).
upload.dropHint: Drag & drop a model folder or a .zip / .tar.gz / .tgz archive here
upload.dropHintSub: Folders keep their directory structure by relative path; archives are extracted automatically on the server
upload.pickedHint: Will upload {{count}} files ({{size}}); large uploads take time — keep this page open
upload.existsHint: Uploads are rejected if the target model already exists; delete the old model first
upload.dropEmpty: No files could be read from the dropped content
upload.dropReadFailed: Failed to read the dropped content
import.description: Use this when the model files are already on the server: enter the path of the directory containing the model files; the backend copies them into the module's model cache directory, skipping the network download.
